text:
Maya (Product): quick check-in on the dense billing row mock I dropped — Figma link in thread. main tension: show enough token detail in compact rows without breaking scanability.
Eli (Design): I tried two tactics: 1) inline micro-badges with thin separators, 2) single condensed summary "5.6k tokens" with chevron to expand. attach images.
Sam (PM): growth says visible numbers win. we lose clicks if users have to expand. prefer inline badges on desktop.
Leo (Eng): perf note: rendering a DOM badge per token slice across hundreds of rows kills paint on older devices. we should either render a single text summary or draw badges in one SVG per row.
Anya (A11y): must avoid hover-only reveals. keyboard focus needs parity with mouse. screen readers require an aria summary for the row (e.g., "Prompt: 4.3k, Completion: 1.2k, Cached: 100"). also confirm contrast ratios for small badge labels.
Maya (Product): proposal: desktop = inline badges (rendered as lightweight SVG text chunk), mobile = condensed summary + tap to expand, keyboard = expand on focus or show inline text. agree?
John (Revenue): CSV/export must map whatever numbers are shown. customers expect columns: token_bucket, model, tokens, cost_usd. please ensure any aggregation maps back deterministically.
Eli (Design): alternate idea: show top-2 buckets inline, and ellipse the rest with a tooltip to expand full breakdown. keeps rows compact.
Sam (PM): top-2 approach might be a good compromise for conversion + density.
Leo (Eng): tooltip/expanded detail must be lazy-loaded. we'll ship aggregated breakdowns in the API to avoid extra round trips.
Anya (A11y): tooltips must be keyboard-triggerable and include role="tooltip". any ellipses should expose full text to assistive tech.
Preview-bot: preview deployed to staging branch: https://preview.redwood/branch/dense-billing-1987 
Maya (Product): action items I took away:
- Desktop: inline badges rendered as single SVG/text block for perf
- Mobile: condensed summary with tap-to-expand
- Keyboard: focus reveals same info as hover; aria-summary for rows
- CSV: ensure columns token_bucket, model, tokens, cost_usd map to visible numbers
- Copy: replace "Estimated monthly spend" with "Projected monthly cost" across billing surfaces
Eli (Design): I'll update mocks with the top-2 + ellipsis variant and annotate color tokens for contrast checks.
Leo (Eng): will run a lightweight perf sweep on older Chrome/Android devices after mocks land.
John (Revenue): ping me when CSV schema is ready; I'll validate mappings.
Anya (A11y): I will add sample ARIA snippets into the figma comments.
Maya (Product): thanks — I'll consolidate decisions in the spec and post a brief Loom once the perf pass is in. :white_check_mark:
